_documentation: Authoritative source for calendar.ics. Maintained by hand alongside the HTML event cards in index.html. When you edit an event here, also update the corresponding <article class="event-card"> in index.html (and its FR/DE siblings), and bump dtstamp. CI fails if calendar.ics drifts from what scripts/build-calendar.py would produce from this file. Entries that also live on Indico can opt into a partial auto-sync by adding an `indicoEventId` field; scripts/sync-indico.py then overwrites the `summary`, `start`, and `end` fields from the fresh Indico payload on each run. `location`, `description`, `url`, `categories`, etc. stay hand-edited (the curated text is richer than what Indico returns).
caldesc: Events from the NetSec COST Action (CA24154): annual conferences, training schools, policy workshops, MC plenaries. Authoritative source: https://netsec-cost.eu/#events

events.description:
Three days of training and mentoring for early-career researchers in European security: research presentations, individualised feedback from senior scholars, and structured mentorship. Open to PhD candidates and post-docs (within one year of defence) in strategic studies and international security, as well as SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS alumni.

Scientific Coordinators: Dr Silvia D'Amato, Prof Chiara Ruffa.

Full details: https://eiss-europa.com/NetSecSchool.html

The flagship annual gathering of the NetSec community: an interdisciplinary conference on European defence and security open to academics, policy-makers, and practitioners. Held back-to-back with the Summer School so early-career scholars can join the wider conversation.

Chairpersons: Dr Julia Carver, Dr Sanne Verschuren.

Live programme: https://netsec-cost.eu/essc-2026.html
Registration: https://indico.eiss-europa.com/event/22/

A NetSec-hosted policy workshop bringing together members of the Action with policy practitioners on a topic to be confirmed. Format and registration details will be published on the Action's website ahead of the date.

A NetSec Inclusiveness Target Country (ITC) Conference, supported by the COST ITC Conference Grant scheme. The format prioritises participation from researchers based in ITCs, with travel-grant support coordinated through the Action. Programme and registration to be published on the Action's website.

The ITC Conference Grant is one of five NetSec grant schemes; see https://netsec-cost.eu/grants.html for the full set.

The Action's first formal Management Committee plenary, bringing together the MC representatives from the participating COST Member countries to align on workstreams, confirm Working Group leadership for the coming cycle, and elect any remaining roles. Followed by a Core Group working session.

Access is restricted to MC representatives, Working Group leads, and invited observers.
